message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.  
Here’s how:

| Step | What to do | Where to go |
|------|------------|-------------|
| **1** | Call the 311 hotline (free from any phone) | 404‑656‑3111 |
| **2** | Use the online 311 portal | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 |
| **3** | Fill out the “Noise Complaint” form | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311/noise |
| **4** | Provide details: location, time, type of noise, and any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings). | Same form |
| **5** | Submit. You’ll receive a case number and a confirmation email. | Online portal |

**Key points**

* Noise complaints are handled by the Atlanta Police Department’s Traffic & Public Safety Division.  
* The city’s noise ordinance allows a maximum of 20 dB during the day (7 a.m.–10 p.m.) and 15 dB at night (10 p.m.–7 a.m.).  
* If the noise is ongoing or you’re dealing with a nuisance, you can also file a “Nuisance Complaint” through the same 311 system.

If you prefer in person, you can visit the City Hall at 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Suite 200, Atlanta, GA 30303, and speak with a clerk.  

Once your complaint is filed, the police will investigate and may issue a warning or citation depending on the severity.
